name: @aliran/epg
description: Aliran EPG service — standalone program-guide publisher: pluggable ingest into an epoch-rotated public Hyperdrive, advertised via the panel's meta/epgKey pointer
comment: Deliberately SEPARATE from the panel: guide management needs no admin services, its churn belongs in a rotatable drive (never the panel's append-only bee), and operators must be able to run it on different hardware. It holds NO admin credentials — a publisher-scoped key writes exactly one panel record (meta/epgKey) at registration and on epoch rotation.
